"""Sign-in by emailed link, sessions, "who am I", and deleting the account."""

import logging
from typing import Annotated

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request, Response
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from sqlmodel import Session, select

from app import accounts, audit
from app.config import Settings, get_settings
from app.db import get_session
from app.integrations import Integrations, for_business, get_integrations, get_practice_integrations
from app.mail.smtp import Mailer, get_mailer
from app.models import Business, Membership, User
from app.safety.access import ACTIVE, ActorDep, COOKIE_VALUE, csrf_for, require_user, visitor_id
from app.tenancy import purge_business

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
router = APIRouter(prefix="/api", tags=["auth"])

EXPIRED = "This link has expired or was already used. Please ask for a new one."
NO_EMAIL = "We couldn't send the email right now. Please try again in a few minutes."


class LinkRequest(BaseModel):
    email: str = Field(max_length=254)
    next: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=200)


def send_link(settings: Settings, mailer: Mailer, session: Session, *, kind: str, email: str, page: str, raw: str,
              next_: str = "") -> dict:
    """Email the link. In DEV_MODE (local only) nothing is emailed and the link is returned instead.
    If the mail server is down we say so: we never pretend an email went out."""
    url = accounts.link_url(settings, page, raw, next_)
    if settings.dev_mode:
        return {"dev_link": url}
    subject, text, html = accounts.link_email(kind, url)
    try:
        mailer.send(to=email, subject=subject, body=text, html=html)
    except Exception as e:
        log.warning("could not send %s email: %s", kind, type(e).__name__)
        audit.record(session, actor="system", action=f"{kind}_email", result="failed", detail=type(e).__name__)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail=NO_EMAIL) from e
    audit.record(session, actor="system", action=f"{kind}_email", result="sent")
    return {}


@router.post("/auth/request-link")
def request_link(body: LinkRequest, request: Request, settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)],
                 session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)],
                 mailer: Annotated[Mailer, Depends(get_mailer)]) -> dict:
    """Always the same answer, whether or not the address has an account, so nobody can find out which emails do."""
    email = accounts.normalize_email(body.email)
    if email is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="That email address doesn't look right. Please check it.")
    visitor = visitor_id(request)
    if accounts.links_last_hour(session, visitor) >= settings.signin_links_per_ip_per_hour:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=429, detail="Too many sign-in links were asked for from here. "
                            "Please wait an hour and try again.")
    out = {"ok": True, "message": accounts.SAME_ANSWER}
    user = accounts.find_user(session, email)
    if user is not None and user.status not in ACTIVE:  # suspended: no link, same answer
        return out
    if accounts.links_today(session, email) >= settings.signin_links_per_email_per_day:
        audit.record(session, actor="system", action="login_email", result="blocked", detail="daily limit for one address")
        return out  # same answer; the limit protects the inbox from being flooded
    raw = accounts.issue_token(session, email, "login", visitor)
    out.update(send_link(settings, mailer, session, kind="login", email=email, page="signin/confirm", raw=raw,
                         next_=accounts.safe_next(body.next)))
    return out


class Confirm(BaseModel):
    token: str = Field(max_length=200)


def me_out(settings: Settings, session: Session, user: User | None, guest_raw: str | None, session_raw: str | None,
           integ_fake: bool) -> dict:
    cookie = session_raw if user is not None else guest_raw
    return {
        "user": {"email": user.email, "status": user.status, "role": user.role,
                 "status_reason": user.status_reason} if user else None,
        "guest": user is None and bool(guest_raw),
        "csrf": csrf_for(cookie) if cookie else None,
        "practice_server": integ_fake,  # true: even approved launches run against the pretend GoDaddy here
        "limits": {"shops": settings.max_shops_per_user},
    }


@router.post("/auth/confirm")
def confirm(body: Confirm, request: Request, response: Response, actor: ActorDep,
            settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)], session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)],
            integ: Annotated[Integrations, Depends(get_integrations)]) -> dict:
    """The "Sign in" button on the confirm page POSTs the token here. Only this uses the token up."""
    row = accounts.consume_token(session, body.token, "login")
    if row is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=EXPIRED)
    user = accounts.user_for_login(session, settings, row.email)
    if user.status not in ACTIVE:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="This account can't sign in right now. "
                            "Please use the contact form on our home page if you think that's a mistake.")
    raw = accounts.create_session(session, settings, user, request.headers.get("user-agent", ""))
    kept = accounts.adopt_guest_shops(session, settings, user, actor.guest)
    accounts.set_session_cookie(response, settings, raw)
    accounts.clear_cookie(response, settings, settings.guest_cookie)
    audit.record(session, actor="owner", action="login", target=f"user:{user.id}", result="ok", user_id=user.id,
                 detail=f"{kept} practice shop(s) kept" if kept else "")
    return {**me_out(settings, session, user, None, raw, integ.fake), "kept_shops": kept}


@router.get("/auth/me")
def me(request: Request, response: Response, actor: ActorDep, settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)],
       session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)],
       integ: Annotated[Integrations, Depends(get_integrations)]) -> dict:
    session_raw = request.cookies.get(settings.session_cookie)
    if session_raw and actor.user is None:  # expired / revoked / suspended: drop the dead cookie
        accounts.clear_cookie(response, settings, settings.session_cookie)
    guest_raw = request.cookies.get(settings.guest_cookie)
    guest_raw = guest_raw if guest_raw and COOKIE_VALUE.match(guest_raw) else None
    response.headers["Cache-Control"] = "no-store"
    return me_out(settings, session, actor.user, guest_raw, session_raw, integ.fake)


@router.post("/auth/logout")
def logout(response: Response, actor: ActorDep, settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)],
           session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)]) -> dict:
    if actor.user is not None and actor.session_row is not None:
        accounts.revoke_sessions(session, actor.user.id, only=actor.session_row)
        audit.record(session, actor="owner", action="logout", target=f"user:{actor.user.id}", result="ok", user_id=actor.user.id)
    accounts.clear_cookie(response, settings, settings.session_cookie)
    return {"ok": True}


@router.post("/auth/logout-all")
def logout_all(response: Response, user: Annotated[User, Depends(require_user)],
               settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)],
               session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)]) -> dict:
    n = accounts.revoke_sessions(session, user.id)
    audit.record(session, actor="owner", action="logout_all", target=f"user:{user.id}", result="ok", user_id=user.id,

"""Sign-in by emailed link, sessions, "who am I", and deleting the account."""

import logging
from typing import Annotated

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request, Response
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from sqlmodel import Session, select

from app import accounts, audit
from app.config import Settings, get_settings
from app.db import get_session
from app.integrations import Integrations, for_business, get_integrations, get_practice_integrations
from app.mail.smtp import Mailer, get_mailer
from app.models import Business, Membership, User
from app.safety.access import ACTIVE, ActorDep, COOKIE_VALUE, csrf_for, require_user, visitor_id
from app.tenancy import purge_business

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
router = APIRouter(prefix="/api", tags=["auth"])

EXPIRED = "This link has expired or was already used. Please ask for a new one."
NO_EMAIL = "We couldn't send the email right now. Please try again in a few minutes."


class LinkRequest(BaseModel):
    email: str = Field(max_length=254)
    next: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=200)


def send_link(settings: Settings, mailer: Mailer, session: Session, *, kind: str, email: str, page: str, raw: str,
              next_: str = "") -> dict:
    """Email the link. In DEV_MODE (local only) nothing is emailed and the link is returned instead.
    If the mail server is down we say so: we never pretend an email went out."""
    url = accounts.link_url(settings, page, raw, next_)
    if settings.dev_mode:
        return {"dev_link": url}
    subject, text, html = accounts.link_email(kind, url)
    try:
        mailer.send(to=email, subject=subject, body=text, html=html)
    except Exception as e:
        log.warning("could not send %s email: %s", kind, type(e).__name__)
        audit.record(session, actor="system", action=f"{kind}_email", result="failed", detail=type(e).__name__)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail=NO_EMAIL) from e
    audit.record(session, actor="system", action=f"{kind}_email", result="sent")
    return {}


@router.post("/auth/request-link")
def request_link(body: LinkRequest, request: Request, settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)],
                 session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)],
                 mailer: Annotated[Mailer, Depends(get_mailer)]) -> dict:
    """Always the same answer, whether or not the address has an account, so nobody can find out which emails do."""
    email = accounts.normalize_email(body.email)
    if email is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="That email address doesn't look right. Please check it.")
    visitor = visitor_id(request)
    if accounts.links_last_hour(session, visitor) >= settings.signin_links_per_ip_per_hour:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=429, detail="Too many sign-in links were asked for from here. "
                            "Please wait an hour and try again.")
    out = {"ok": True, "message": accounts.SAME_ANSWER}
    user = accounts.find_user(session, email)
    if user is not None and user.status not in ACTIVE:  # suspended: no link, same answer
        return out
    if accounts.links_today(session, email) >= settings.signin_links_per_email_per_day:
        audit.record(session, actor="system", action="login_email", result="blocked", detail="daily limit for one address")
        return out  # same answer; the limit protects the inbox from being flooded
    raw = accounts.issue_token(session, email, "login", visitor)
    out.update(send_link(settings, mailer, session, kind="login", email=email, page="signin/confirm", raw=raw,
                         next_=accounts.safe_next(body.next)))
    return out


class Confirm(BaseModel):
    token: str = Field(max_length=200)


def me_out(settings: Settings, session: Session, user: User | None, guest_raw: str | None, session_raw: str | None,
           integ_fake: bool) -> dict:
    cookie = session_raw if user is not None else guest_raw
    return {
        "user": {"email": user.email, "status": user.status, "role": user.role,
                 "status_reason": user.status_reason} if user else None,
        "guest": user is None and bool(guest_raw),
        "csrf": csrf_for(cookie) if cookie else None,
        "practice_server": integ_fake,  # true: even approved launches run against the pretend GoDaddy here
        "limits": {"shops": settings.max_shops_per_user},
    }


@router.post("/auth/confirm")
def confirm(body: Confirm, request: Request, response: Response, actor: ActorDep,
            settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)], session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)],
            integ: Annotated[Integrations, Depends(get_integrations)]) -> dict:
    """The "Sign in" button on the confirm page POSTs the token here. Only this uses the token up."""
    row = accounts.consume_token(session, body.token, "login")
    if row is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=EXPIRED)
    user = accounts.user_for_login(session, settings, row.email)
    if user.status not in ACTIVE:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="This account can't sign in right now. "
                            "Please use the contact form on our home page if you think that's a mistake.")
    raw = accounts.create_session(session, settings, user, request.headers.get("user-agent", ""))
    kept = accounts.adopt_guest_shops(session, settings, user, actor.guest)
    accounts.set_session_cookie(response, settings, raw)
    accounts.clear_cookie(response, settings, settings.guest_cookie)
    audit.record(session, actor="owner", action="login", target=f"user:{user.id}", result="ok", user_id=user.id,
                 detail=f"{kept} practice shop(s) kept" if kept else "")
    return {**me_out(settings, session, user, None, raw, integ.fake), "kept_shops": kept}


@router.get("/auth/me")
def me(request: Request, response: Response, actor: ActorDep, settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)],
       session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)],
       integ: Annotated[Integrations, Depends(get_integrations)]) -> dict:
    session_raw = request.cookies.get(settings.session_cookie)
    if session_raw and actor.user is None:  # expired / revoked / suspended: drop the dead cookie
        accounts.clear_cookie(response, settings, settings.session_cookie)
    guest_raw = request.cookies.get(settings.guest_cookie)
    guest_raw = guest_raw if guest_raw and COOKIE_VALUE.match(guest_raw) else None
    response.headers["Cache-Control"] = "no-store"
    return me_out(settings, session, actor.user, guest_raw, session_raw, integ.fake)


@router.post("/auth/logout")
def logout(response: Response, actor: ActorDep, settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)],
           session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)]) -> dict:
    if actor.user is not None and actor.session_row is not None:
        accounts.revoke_sessions(session, actor.user.id, only=actor.session_row)
        audit.record(session, actor="owner", action="logout", target=f"user:{actor.user.id}", result="ok", user_id=actor.user.id)
    accounts.clear_cookie(response, settings, settings.session_cookie)
    return {"ok": True}


@router.post("/auth/logout-all")
def logout_all(response: Response, user: Annotated[User, Depends(require_user)],
               settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)],
               session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)]) -> dict:
    n = accounts.revoke_sessions(session, user.id)
    audit.record(session, actor="owner", action="logout_all", target=f"user:{user.id}", result="ok", user_id=user.id,
                 detail=f"{n} session(s) ended")
    accounts.clear_cookie(response, settings, settings.session_cookie)
    return {"ok": True, "ended": n}


# ---------- deleting the account (confirmed by an emailed link) ----------

@router.post("/account/delete-request")
def delete_request(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(require_user)],
                   settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)],
                   session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)],
                   mailer: Annotated[Mailer, Depends(get_mailer)]) -> dict:
    if accounts.links_today(session, user.email) >= settings.signin_links_per_email_per_day:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=429, detail="You've asked for several emails today. Please try again tomorrow.")
    raw = accounts.issue_token(session, user.email, "delete_account", visitor_id(request))
    out = {"ok": True, "message": "We've emailed you a link to confirm. Nothing is deleted until you use it."}
    out.update(send_link(settings, mailer, session, kind="delete_account", email=user.email, page="account/delete", raw=raw))
    return out


@router.post("/account/delete")
def delete_account(body: Confirm, response: Response, user: Annotated[User, Depends(require_user)],
                   settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)],
                   session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)],
                   server: Annotated[Integrations, Depends(get_integrations)],
                   practice: Annotated[Integrations, Depends(get_practice_integrations)]) -> dict:
    """Unpublish and delete the user's shops, remove memberships and personal data, end every
    session, and keep one anonymous audit record. Needs the emailed link AND being signed in."""
    row = accounts.consume_token(session, body.token, "delete_account")
    if row is None or row.email != user.email:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=EXPIRED)
    if user.role == "admin":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="The admin account can't be deleted here.")
    shops = session.exec(select(Business).join(Membership, Membership.business_id == Business.id)
                         .where(Membership.user_id == user.id, Membership.role == "owner")).all()
    for b in shops:

"""Team (admin) pages: approval queue, users, shops, reports. Every action is written to the audit log."""

import logging
from typing import Annotated

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from sqlmodel import Session, select

from app import accounts, audit
from app.config import Settings, get_settings
from app.db import get_session
from app.mail.smtp import Mailer, get_mailer
from app.models import Business, Membership, ShopReport, User
from app.safety.access import Actor, require_admin
from app.sites.hosts import is_public, site_url

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/admin", tags=["admin"])
AdminDep = Annotated[Actor, Depends(require_admin)]


def iso(v) -> str | None:
    return v.replace(tzinfo=None).isoformat() + "Z" if v else None


def user_out(session: Session, u: User) -> dict:
    shops = session.exec(select(Business.name).join(Membership, Membership.business_id == Business.id)
                         .where(Membership.user_id == u.id)).all()
    return {"id": u.id, "email": u.email, "status": u.status, "role": u.role, "status_reason": u.status_reason,
            "created_at": iso(u.created_at), "last_login_at": iso(u.last_login_at), "shops": list(shops)}


def tell(mailer: Mailer, session: Session, user: User, subject: str, body: str) -> bool:
    """Email the user about a decision. A mail failure never undoes the decision; it is logged."""
    try:
        mailer.send(to=user.email, subject=subject, body=body + "\n\n- LaunchWitness")
        return True
    except Exception as e:
        log.warning("could not email a decision: %s", type(e).__name__)
        audit.record(session, actor="system", action="decision_email", target=f"user:{user.id}", result="failed",
                     detail=type(e).__name__)
        return False


def get_user(session: Session, user_id: int) -> User:
    u = session.get(User, user_id)
    if u is None or u.status == "deleted":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="We couldn't find that user.")
    return u


class Reason(BaseModel):
    reason: str = Field(default="", max_length=300)


@router.get("/check")
def admin_check(_admin: AdminDep) -> dict:
    return {"admin": True}


@router.get("/users")
def users(admin: AdminDep, session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)], status: str | None = None) -> list[dict]:
    q = select(User).where(User.status != "deleted")
    if status:
        q = q.where(User.status == status)
    rows = session.exec(q.order_by(User.id.desc()).limit(500)).all()
    audit.record(session, actor="admin", action="admin_list_users", result="ok", user_id=admin.user_id,
                 detail=f"{len(rows)} row(s), status={status or 'any'}")
    return [user_out(session, u) for u in rows]


@router.post("/users/{user_id}/approve")
def approve_user(user_id: int, admin: AdminDep, settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)],
                 session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)],
                 mailer: Annotated[Mailer, Depends(get_mailer)]) -> dict:
    u = get_user(session, user_id)
    u.status, u.status_reason = "approved", ""
    session.add(u)
    session.commit()
    audit.record(session, actor="admin", action="user_approved", target=f"user:{u.id}", result="ok", user_id=admin.user_id)
    emailed = tell(mailer, session, u, "You're approved on LaunchWitness",
                   "Good news: your LaunchWitness account is approved. You can now launch your shop for real.\n\n"
                   f"Sign in here: {settings.app_base_url.rstrip('/')}/#/signin")
    return {**user_out(session, u), "emailed": emailed}


def _suspend(session: Session, u: User, reason: str) -> int:
    u.status, u.status_reason = "suspended", reason.strip()
    session.add(u)
    paused = 0
    for b in session.exec(select(Business).join(Membership, Membership.business_id == Business.id)
                          .where(Membership.user_id == u.id)).all():
        if not b.paused:
            b.paused, b.paused_reason, paused = True, "owner's account is suspended", paused + 1
            session.add(b)
    session.commit()
    accounts.revoke_sessions(session, u.id)
    return paused


@router.post("/users/{user_id}/reject")
def reject_user(user_id: int, body: Reason, admin: AdminDep, session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)],
                mailer: Annotated[Mailer, Depends(get_mailer)]) -> dict:
    """Turn down a sign-up: the account can't sign in; the user gets the reason by email."""
    u = get_user(session, user_id)
    if u.role == "admin":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="The admin account can't be rejected.")
    _suspend(session, u, body.reason)
    audit.record(session, actor="admin", action="user_rejected", target=f"user:{u.id}", result="ok",
                 user_id=admin.user_id, detail=body.reason)
    emailed = tell(mailer, session, u, "About your LaunchWitness sign-up",
                   "Thank you for signing up. We can't approve your account right now."
                   + (f"\n\nReason: {body.reason.strip()}" if body.reason.strip() else "")
                   + "\n\nIf you think this is a mistake, reply through the contact form on our home page.")
    return {**user_out(session, u), "emailed": emailed}


@router.post("/users/{user_id}/suspend")
def suspend_user(user_id: int, body: Reason, admin: AdminDep, session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)],
                 mailer: Annotated[Mailer, Depends(get_mailer)]) -> dict:
    """Suspended users can't sign in, every session ends at once, and their shops are paused."""
    u = get_user(session, user_id)
    if u.role == "admin":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="The admin account can't be suspended.")
    paused = _suspend(session, u, body.reason)
    audit.record(session, actor="admin", action="user_suspended", target=f"user:{u.id}", result="ok",
                 user_id=admin.user_id, detail=f"{body.reason} ({paused} shop(s) paused)")
    emailed = tell(mailer, session, u, "Your LaunchWitness account is suspended",
                   "Your LaunchWitness account has been suspended and your shops are paused."
                   + (f"\n\nReason: {body.reason.strip()}" if body.reason.strip() else "")
                   + "\n\nIf you think this is a mistake, reply through the contact form on our home page.")
    return {**user_out(session, u), "emailed": emailed, "shops_paused": paused}


@router.get("/businesses")
def businesses(admin: AdminDep, settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)],
               session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)]) -> list[dict]:
    rows = session.exec(select(Business).order_by(Business.id.desc()).limit(500)).all()
    audit.record(session, actor="admin", action="admin_list_shops", result="ok", user_id=admin.user_id,
                 detail=f"{len(rows)} row(s)")
    out = []
    for b in rows:
        owners = session.exec(select(User.email).join(Membership, Membership.user_id == User.id)
                              .where(Membership.business_id == b.id)).all()
        out.append({"id": b.id, "name": b.name, "subdomain": b.subdomain, "status": b.status, "practice": b.practice,
                    "public": is_public(b) and not b.paused, "paused": b.paused, "paused_reason": b.paused_reason,
                    "review": b.review, "review_reason": b.review_reason, "guest": bool(b.guest_hash),
                    "owners": list(owners), "site_url": site_url(b.subdomain, settings) if b.subdomain else None,
                    "created_at": iso(b.created_at)})
    return out


def get_business(session: Session, business_id: int) -> Business:
    b = session.get(Business, business_id)
    if b is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="We couldn't find that shop.")
    return b


@router.post("/businesses/{business_id}/pause")
def pause(business_id: int, body: Reason, admin: AdminDep, session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)]) -> dict:
    """Takes effect on the very next request: the shop shows a neutral "This shop is paused" page."""
    b = get_business(session, business_id)
    b.paused, b.paused_reason = True, body.reason.strip()
    session.add(b)
    session.commit()
    audit.record(session, actor="admin", action="shop_paused", target=f"business:{b.id}", result="ok",
                 business_id=b.id, user_id=admin.user_id, detail=body.reason)
    return {"ok": True, "paused": True}


@router.post("/businesses/{business_id}/unpause")
def unpause(business_id: int, admin: AdminDep, session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)]) -> dict:
    b = get_business(session, business_id)
    b.paused, b.paused_reason = False, ""
    session.add(b)
    session.commit()
    audit.record(session, actor="admin", action="shop_unpaused", target=f"business:{b.id}", result="ok",
                 business_id=b.id, user_id=admin.user_id)
    return {"ok": True, "paused": False}


@router.post("/businesses/{business_id}/clear-review")
def clear_review(business_id: int, admin: AdminDep, session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)]) -> dict:
    """A shop held by the go-live policy check may launch once the team has looked at it."""
    b = get_business(session, business_id)
    b.review, b.review_reason = "cleared", ""
    session.add(b)
    session.commit()
    audit.record(session, actor="admin", action="shop_review_cleared", target=f"business:{b.id}", result="ok",
                 business_id=b.id, user_id=admin.user_id)
    return {"ok": True, "review": "cleared"}


@router.get("/reports")
def reports(admin: AdminDep, session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)], status: str = "open") -> list[dict]:
    rows = session.exec(select(ShopReport).where(ShopReport.status == status).order_by(ShopReport.id.desc()).limit(500)).all()
    out = []
    for r in rows:
        b = session.get(Business, r.business_id)
        out.append({"id": r.id, "business_id": r.business_id, "shop": b.name if b else "(deleted)",
                    "subdomain": b.subdomain if b else None, "paused": bool(b and b.paused), "reason": r.reason,
                    "note": r.note, "status": r.status, "created_at": iso(r.created_at)})
    return out


@router.post("/reports/{report_id}/close")
def close_report(report_id: int, body: Reason, admin: AdminDep, session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)]) -> dict:
    r = session.get(ShopReport, report_id)
    if r is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="We couldn't find that report.")
    r.status, r.closed_note = "closed", body.reason.strip()
    session.add(r)
    session.commit()
    audit.record(session, actor="admin", action="report_closed", target=f"report:{r.id}", result="ok",
                 business_id=r.business_id, user_id=admin.user_id, detail=body.reason)
    return {"ok": True}

def tell(mailer: Mailer, session: Session, user: User, subject: str, body: str) -> bool:
    """Email the user about a decision. A mail failure never undoes the decision; it is logged."""
    try:
        mailer.send(to=user.email, subject=subject, body=body + "\n\n- LaunchWitness")
        return True
    except Exception as e:
        log.warning("could not email a decision: %s", type(e).__name__)
        audit.record(session, actor="system", action="decision_email", target=f"user:{user.id}", result="failed",
                     detail=type(e).__name__)
        return False


def get_user(session: Session, user_id: int) -> User:
    u = session.get(User, user_id)
    if u is None or u.status == "deleted":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="We couldn't find that user.")
    return u


class Reason(BaseModel):
    reason: str = Field(default="", max_length=300)


@router.get("/check")
def admin_check(_admin: AdminDep) -> dict:
    return {"admin": True}


@router.get("/users")
def users(admin: AdminDep, session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)], status: str | None = None) -> list[dict]:
    q = select(User).where(User.status != "deleted")
    if status:
        q = q.where(User.status == status)
    rows = session.exec(q.order_by(User.id.desc()).limit(500)).all()
    audit.record(session, actor="admin", action="admin_list_users", result="ok", user_id=admin.user_id,
                 detail=f"{len(rows)} row(s), status={status or 'any'}")
    return [user_out(session, u) for u in rows]


@router.post("/users/{user_id}/approve")
def approve_user(user_id: int, admin: AdminDep, settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)],
                 session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)],
                 mailer: Annotated[Mailer, Depends(get_mailer)]) -> dict:
    u = get_user(session, user_id)
    u.status, u.status_reason = "approved", ""
    session.add(u)
    session.commit()
    audit.record(session, actor="admin", action="user_approved", target=f"user:{u.id}", result="ok", user_id=admin.user_id)
    emailed = tell(mailer, session, u, "You're approved on LaunchWitness",
                   "Good news: your LaunchWitness account is approved. You can now launch your shop for real.\n\n"
                   f"Sign in here: {settings.app_base_url.rstrip('/')}/#/signin")
    return {**user_out(session, u), "emailed": emailed}


def _suspend(session: Session, u: User, reason: str) -> int:
    u.status, u.status_reason = "suspended", reason.strip()
    session.add(u)
    paused = 0
    for b in session.exec(select(Business).join(Membership, Membership.business_id == Business.id)
                          .where(Membership.user_id == u.id)).all():
        if not b.paused:
            b.paused, b.paused_reason, paused = True, "owner's account is suspended", paused + 1
            session.add(b)
    session.commit()
    accounts.revoke_sessions(session, u.id)
    return paused


@router.post("/users/{user_id}/reject")
def reject_user(user_id: int, body: Reason, admin: AdminDep, session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)],
                mailer: Annotated[Mailer, Depends(get_mailer)]) -> dict:
    """Turn down a sign-up: the account can't sign in; the user gets the reason by email."""
    u = get_user(session, user_id)
    if u.role == "admin":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="The admin account can't be rejected.")
    _suspend(session, u, body.reason)
    audit.record(session, actor="admin", action="user_rejected", target=f"user:{u.id}", result="ok",
                 user_id=admin.user_id, detail=body.reason)
    emailed = tell(mailer, session, u, "About your LaunchWitness sign-up",
                   "Thank you for signing up. We can't approve your account right now."
                   + (f"\n\nReason: {body.reason.strip()}" if body.reason.strip() else "")
                   + "\n\nIf you think this is a mistake, reply through the contact form on our home page.")
    return {**user_out(session, u), "emailed": emailed}


@router.post("/users/{user_id}/suspend")
def suspend_user(user_id: int, body: Reason, admin: AdminDep, session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)],
                 mailer: Annotated[Mailer, Depends(get_mailer)]) -> dict:
    """Suspended users can't sign in, every session ends at once, and their shops are paused."""
    u = get_user(session, user_id)
    if u.role == "admin":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="The admin account can't be suspended.")
    paused = _suspend(session, u, body.reason)
    audit.record(session, actor="admin", action="user_suspended", target=f"user:{u.id}", result="ok",
                 user_id=admin.user_id, detail=f"{body.reason} ({paused} shop(s) paused)")
    emailed = tell(mailer, session, u, "Your LaunchWitness account is suspended",
                   "Your LaunchWitness account has been suspended and your shops are paused."
                   + (f"\n\nReason: {body.reason.strip()}" if body.reason.strip() else "")
                   + "\n\nIf you think this is a mistake, reply through the contact form on our home page.")
    return {**user_out(session, u), "emailed": emailed, "shops_paused": paused}


@router.get("/businesses")
def businesses(admin: AdminDep, settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)],
               session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)]) -> list[dict]:

    audit.record(session, actor="admin", action="admin_list_shops", result="ok", user_id=admin.user_id,
                 detail=f"{len(rows)} row(s)")
    out = []
    for b in rows:
        owners = session.exec(select(User.email).join(Membership, Membership.user_id == User.id)
                              .where(Membership.business_id == b.id)).all()
        out.append({"id": b.id, "name": b.name, "subdomain": b.subdomain, "status": b.status, "practice": b.practice,
                    "public": is_public(b) and not b.paused, "paused": b.paused, "paused_reason": b.paused_reason,
                    "review": b.review, "review_reason": b.review_reason, "guest": bool(b.guest_hash),
                    "owners": list(owners), "site_url": site_url(b.subdomain, settings) if b.subdomain else None,
                    "created_at": iso(b.created_at)})
    return out


def get_business(session: Session, business_id: int) -> Business:
    b = session.get(Business, business_id)
    if b is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="We couldn't find that shop.")
    return b


@router.post("/businesses/{business_id}/pause")
def pause(business_id: int, body: Reason, admin: AdminDep, session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)]) -> dict:
    """Takes effect on the very next request: the shop shows a neutral "This shop is paused" page."""
    b = get_business(session, business_id)

"""Sign-in by emailed link, sessions, "who am I", and deleting the account."""

import logging
from typing import Annotated

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request, Response
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from sqlmodel import Session, select

from app import accounts, audit
from app.config import Settings, get_settings
from app.db import get_session
from app.integrations import Integrations, for_business, get_integrations, get_practice_integrations
from app.mail.smtp import Mailer, get_mailer
from app.models import Business, Membership, User
from app.safety.access import ACTIVE, ActorDep, COOKIE_VALUE, csrf_for, require_user, visitor_id
from app.tenancy import purge_business

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
router = APIRouter(prefix="/api", tags=["auth"])

EXPIRED = "This link has expired or was already used. Please ask for a new one."
NO_EMAIL = "We couldn't send the email right now. Please try again in a few minutes."


class LinkRequest(BaseModel):
    email: str = Field(max_length=254)
    next: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=200)


def send_link(settings: Settings, mailer: Mailer, session: Session, *, kind: str, email: str, page: str, raw: str,
              next_: str = "") -> dict:
    """Email the link. In DEV_MODE (local only) nothing is emailed and the link is returned instead.
    If the mail server is down we say so: we never pretend an email went out."""
    url = accounts.link_url(settings, page, raw, next_)
    if settings.dev_mode:
        return {"dev_link": url}
    subject, text, html = accounts.link_email(kind, url)
    try:
        mailer.send(to=email, subject=subject, body=text, html=html)
    except Exception as e:
        log.warning("could not send %s email: %s", kind, type(e).__name__)
        audit.record(session, actor="system", action=f"{kind}_email", result="failed", detail=type(e).__name__)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail=NO_EMAIL) from e
    audit.record(session, actor="system", action=f"{kind}_email", result="sent")
    return {}


@router.post("/auth/request-link")
def request_link(body: LinkRequest, request: Request, settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)],
                 session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)],
                 mailer: Annotated[Mailer, Depends(get_mailer)]) -> dict:
    """Always the same answer, whether or not the address has an account, so nobody can find out which emails do."""
    email = accounts.normalize_email(body.email)
    if email is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="That email address doesn't look right. Please check it.")
    visitor = visitor_id(request)
    if accounts.links_last_hour(session, visitor) >= settings.signin_links_per_ip_per_hour:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=429, detail="Too many sign-in links were asked for from here. "
                            "Please wait an hour and try again.")
    out = {"ok": True, "message": accounts.SAME_ANSWER}
    user = accounts.find_user(session, email)
    if user is not None and user.status not in ACTIVE:  # suspended: no link, same answer
        return out
    if accounts.links_today(session, email) >= settings.signin_links_per_email_per_day:
        audit.record(session, actor="system", action="login_email", result="blocked", detail="daily limit for one address")
        return out  # same answer; the limit protects the inbox from being flooded
    raw = accounts.issue_token(session, email, "login", visitor)
    out.update(send_link(settings, mailer, session, kind="login", email=email, page="signin/confirm", raw=raw,
                         next_=accounts.safe_next(body.next)))
    return out


class Confirm(BaseModel):
    token: str = Field(max_length=200)


def me_out(settings: Settings, session: Session, user: User | None, guest_raw: str | None, session_raw: str | None,
           integ_fake: bool) -> dict:
    cookie = session_raw if user is not None else guest_raw
    return {
        "user": {"email": user.email, "status": user.status, "role": user.role,
                 "status_reason": user.status_reason} if user else None,
        "guest": user is None and bool(guest_raw),
        "csrf": csrf_for(cookie) if cookie else None,
        "practice_server": integ_fake,  # true: even approved launches run against the pretend GoDaddy here
        "limits": {"shops": settings.max_shops_per_user},
    }


@router.post("/auth/confirm")
def confirm(body: Confirm, request: Request, response: Response, actor: ActorDep,
            settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)], session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)],
            integ: Annotated[Integrations, Depends(get_integrations)]) -> dict:
    """The "Sign in" button on the confirm page POSTs the token here. Only this uses the token up."""
    row = accounts.consume_token(session, body.token, "login")
    if row is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=EXPIRED)
    user = accounts.user_for_login(session, settings, row.email)
    if user.status not in ACTIVE:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="This account can't sign in right now. "
                            "Please use the contact form on our home page if you think that's a mistake.")
    raw = accounts.create_session(session, settings, user, request.headers.get("user-agent", ""))
    kept = accounts.adopt_guest_shops(session, settings, user, actor.guest)
    accounts.set_session_cookie(response, settings, raw)
    accounts.clear_cookie(response, settings, settings.guest_cookie)
    audit.record(session, actor="owner", action="login", target=f"user:{user.id}", result="ok", user_id=user.id,
                 detail=f"{kept} practice shop(s) kept" if kept else "")
    return {**me_out(settings, session, user, None, raw, integ.fake), "kept_shops": kept}


@router.get("/auth/me")
def me(request: Request, response: Response, actor: ActorDep, settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)],
       session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)],
       integ: Annotated[Integrations, Depends(get_integrations)]) -> dict:
    session_raw = request.cookies.get(settings.session_cookie)
    if session_raw and actor.user is None:  # expired / revoked / suspended: drop the dead cookie
        accounts.clear_cookie(response, settings, settings.session_cookie)
    guest_raw = request.cookies.get(settings.guest_cookie)
    guest_raw = guest_raw if guest_raw and COOKIE_VALUE.match(guest_raw) else None
    response.headers["Cache-Control"] = "no-store"
    return me_out(settings, session, actor.user, guest_raw, session_raw, integ.fake)


@router.post("/auth/logout")
def logout(response: Response, actor: ActorDep, settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)],
           session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)]) -> dict:
    if actor.user is not None and actor.session_row is not None:
        accounts.revoke_sessions(session, actor.user.id, only=actor.session_row)
        audit.record(session, actor="owner", action="logout", target=f"user:{actor.user.id}", result="ok", user_id=actor.user.id)
    accounts.clear_cookie(response, settings, settings.session_cookie)
    return {"ok": True}


@router.post("/auth/logout-all")
def logout_all(response: Response, user: Annotated[User, Depends(require_user)],
               settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)],
               session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)]) -> dict:
    n = accounts.revoke_sessions(session, user.id)
    audit.record(session, actor="owner", action="logout_all", target=f"user:{user.id}", result="ok", user_id=user.id,
                 detail=f"{n} session(s) ended")
    accounts.clear_cookie(response, settings, settings.session_cookie)
    return {"ok": True, "ended": n}


# ---------- deleting the account (confirmed by an emailed link) ----------

@router.post("/account/delete-request")
def delete_request(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(require_user)],
                   settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)],
                   session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)],
                   mailer: Annotated[Mailer, Depends(get_mailer)]) -> dict:
    if accounts.links_today(session, user.email) >= settings.signin_links_per_email_per_day:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=429, detail="You've asked for several emails today. Please try again tomorrow.")
    raw = accounts.issue_token(session, user.email, "delete_account", visitor_id(request))
    out = {"ok": True, "message": "We've emailed you a link to confirm. Nothing is deleted until you use it."}
    out.update(send_link(settings, mailer, session, kind="delete_account", email=user.email, page="account/delete", raw=raw))
    return out


@router.post("/account/delete")
def delete_account(body: Confirm, response: Response, user: Annotated[User, Depends(require_user)],
                   settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)],
                   session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)],
                   server: Annotated[Integrations, Depends(get_integrations)],
                   practice: Annotated[Integrations, Depends(get_practice_integrations)]) -> dict:
    """Unpublish and delete the user's shops, remove memberships and personal data, end every
    session, and keep one anonymous audit record. Needs the emailed link AND being signed in."""
    row = accounts.consume_token(session, body.token, "delete_account")
    if row is None or row.email != user.email:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=EXPIRED)
    if user.role == "admin":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="The admin account can't be deleted here.")
    shops = session.exec(select(Business).join(Membership, Membership.business_id == Business.id)
                         .where(Membership.user_id == user.id, Membership.role == "owner")).all()
    for b in shops:
        purge_business(session, settings, for_business(b, server, practice), b)
    user_id = user.id
    accounts.revoke_sessions(session, user_id)
    user.email, user.status, user.status_reason = f"deleted-{user_id}@deleted.invalid", "deleted", ""
    session.add(user)
    session.commit()
    audit.record(session, actor="owner", action="account_deleted", target=f"user:{user_id}", result="ok",
                 detail=f"{len(shops)} shop(s) removed; email erased")  # no email, no shop names
    accounts.clear_cookie(response, settings, settings.session_cookie)
    return {"ok": True}

    audit.record(session, actor="admin", action="user_rejected", target=f"user:{u.id}", result="ok",

                   + (f"\n\nReason: {body.reason.strip()}" if body.reason.strip() else "")
                   + "\n\nIf you think this is a mistake, reply through the contact form on our home page.")

    """Suspended users can't sign in, every session ends at once, and their shops are paused."""
    u = get_user(session, user_id)
    if u.role == "admin":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="The admin account can't be suspended.")
    paused = _suspend(session, u, body.reason)
    audit.record(session, actor="admin", action="user_suspended", target=f"user:{u.id}", result="ok",

import re
from pathlib import Path


def sub(path, old, new, count=1):
    p = Path(path)
    s = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert old in s, (path, old[:70])
    p.write_text(s.replace(old, new, count), encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")


def resub(path, pattern, new):
    p = Path(path)
    s = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    s2, n = re.subn(pattern, new, s)
    assert n, (path, pattern)
    p.write_text(s2, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")

def sub(path, old, new, count=1):
    p = Path(path)
    s = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert old in s, (path, old[:70])
    p.write_text(s.replace(old, new, count), encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")

    p = Path(path)
    s = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    s2, n = re.subn(pattern, new, s)

    p.write_text(s2, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")

import re
from pathlib import Path


def sub(path, old, new, count=1):
    p = Path(path)
    s = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert old in s, (path, old[:70])
    p.write_text(s.replace(old, new, count), encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")


def resub(path, pattern, new):
    p = Path(path)
    s = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    s2, n = re.subn(pattern, new, s)
    assert n, (path, pattern)
    p.write_text(s2, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")

"""Every route of the app, classified. A route that isn't listed here can't ship: a test walks
the real app and fails on any route missing from this table (and on any stale entry), and
checks that each route really uses the gate its class promises.

Classes
- public:   anyone. No sign-in needed. (Lists and creations are still limited to the caller's own things.)
- auth:     a signed-in user (`require_user`).
- owner:    the owner of the business in the URL (`require_business_access` / `require_plan_access`);
            someone else's id answers 404.
- admin:    the team (`require_admin`).
- internal: only reachable on the private network (Caddy answers 404 for /internal/* from outside).
"""

from collections.abc import Iterator

PUBLIC, AUTH, OWNER, ADMIN, INTERNAL = "public", "auth", "owner", "admin", "internal"

ROUTES: dict[tuple[str, str], str] = {
    # --- app shell and public pages ---
    ("GET", "/{path:path}"): PUBLIC,  # landing page, built frontend, /build; on a shop host: the shop's pages
    ("MOUNT", "/assets"): PUBLIC,
    ("GET", "/api/health"): PUBLIC,
    ("GET", "/api/samples"): PUBLIC,
    ("POST", "/api/contact"): PUBLIC,
    # --- public shop pages (served on shop hosts only) ---
    ("POST", "/order"): PUBLIC,
    ("POST", "/report-shop"): PUBLIC,
    # --- sign-in ---
    ("POST", "/api/auth/request-link"): PUBLIC,
    ("POST", "/api/auth/confirm"): PUBLIC,
    ("GET", "/api/auth/me"): PUBLIC,
    ("POST", "/api/auth/logout"): PUBLIC,  # ends the caller's own session, if any
    ("POST", "/api/auth/logout-all"): AUTH,
    ("POST", "/api/account/delete-request"): AUTH,
    ("POST", "/api/account/delete"): AUTH,
    # --- shops: creating and listing are open to guests (practice), and only ever touch the caller's own ---
    ("POST", "/api/businesses"): PUBLIC,
    ("GET", "/api/businesses"): PUBLIC,
    # --- everything that belongs to one business ---
    ("GET", "/api/businesses/{business_id}"): OWNER,
    ("PUT", "/api/businesses/{business_id}"): OWNER,
    ("DELETE", "/api/businesses/{business_id}"): OWNER,
    ("GET", "/api/businesses/{business_id}/preview"): OWNER,
    ("GET", "/api/businesses/{business_id}/orders"): OWNER,
    ("GET", "/api/businesses/{business_id}/export"): OWNER,
    ("GET", "/api/businesses/{business_id}/names"): OWNER,
    ("POST", "/api/businesses/{business_id}/plans"): OWNER,
    ("GET", "/api/businesses/{business_id}/plans"): OWNER,
    ("GET", "/api/businesses/{business_id}/report"): OWNER,
    ("POST", "/api/businesses/{business_id}/checks"): OWNER,
    ("GET", "/api/plans/{plan_id}"): OWNER,
    ("POST", "/api/plans/{plan_id}/approve"): OWNER,
    ("POST", "/api/plans/{plan_id}/resume"): OWNER,
    ("POST", "/api/plans/{plan_id}/practice-buy"): OWNER,
    # --- team ---
    ("GET", "/api/admin/check"): ADMIN,
    ("GET", "/api/admin/users"): ADMIN,
    ("POST", "/api/admin/users/{user_id}/approve"): ADMIN,
    ("POST", "/api/admin/users/{user_id}/reject"): ADMIN,
    ("POST", "/api/admin/users/{user_id}/suspend"): ADMIN,
    ("GET", "/api/admin/businesses"): ADMIN,
    ("POST", "/api/admin/businesses/{business_id}/pause"): ADMIN,
    ("POST", "/api/admin/businesses/{business_id}/unpause"): ADMIN,
    ("POST", "/api/admin/businesses/{business_id}/clear-review"): ADMIN,
    ("PUT", "/api/admin/businesses/{business_id}/demo-fault"): ADMIN,
    ("DELETE", "/api/admin/practice-businesses/{business_id}"): ADMIN,
    ("GET", "/api/admin/reports"): ADMIN,
    ("POST", "/api/admin/reports/{report_id}/close"): ADMIN,
    # --- private network only ---
    ("GET", "/internal/tls-ask"): INTERNAL,
}


def walk(routes) -> Iterator:
    """Every real route of the app, including those inside included routers."""
    for r in routes:
        inner = getattr(r, "original_router", None)
        if inner is not None:
            yield from walk(inner.routes)
        else:
            yield r


def app_routes(app) -> list[tuple[str, str, object]]:
    """(METHOD, path, route) for every route; a mounted directory is METHOD "MOUNT"."""
    out = []
    for r in walk(app.routes):
        methods = [m for m in (getattr(r, "methods", None) or []) if m not in ("HEAD", "OPTIONS")]
        if not methods:
            out.append(("MOUNT", r.path, r))
        out.extend((m, r.path, r) for m in sorted(methods))
    return out


def gate_calls(route) -> set[str]:
    """Names of every dependency function the route uses (searched through sub-dependencies)."""
    seen: set[str] = set()

    def visit(dep) -> None:
        for d in getattr(dep, "dependencies", []):
            call = getattr(d, "call", None)
            if call is not None:
                seen.add(getattr(call, "__name__", ""))
            visit(d)

    if getattr(route, "dependant", None) is not None:
        visit(route.dependant)
    return seen

def two_worlds_client(make_settings, engine, mailer, claude, **settings_kw):
    from app.config import get_settings
    from app.db import get_session
    from app.integrations import get_integrations, get_practice_integrations
    from app.mail.smtp import get_mailer
    from app.main import create_app
    from app.routers.businesses import get_claude

    settings = make_settings(use_fakes=False, **settings_kw)
    server = fake_integrations(settings)
    server.fake = False  # stands in for the REAL GoDaddy/DNS/mail on the VPS
    practice = fake_integrations(settings)
    app = create_app(run_lifespan=False)

    def _session():
        with Session(engine) as s:
            yield s

    app.dependency_overrides.update({get_settings: lambda: settings, get_session: _session,
                                     get_mailer: lambda: mailer, get_claude: lambda: claude,
                                     get_integrations: lambda: server, get_practice_integrations: lambda: practice})
    return TestClient(app), server, practice


def test_public_visitor_on_real_server_is_always_practice(make_settings, engine, mailer, claude):

    with c:
        assert c.get("/api/practice-mode").json() == {"practice": True, "admin": False}
        biz = meera(c)
        assert biz["practice"]
        p = approve(c, plan(c, biz))
        assert p["status"] == "done"
        assert server.godaddy.writes() == [] and server.godaddy.calls == []  # real world untouched
        assert practice.godaddy.writes()
        assert c.get(f"/api/plans/{p['id']}").json()["practice"]

        c.headers.update(ADMIN)
        assert c.get("/api/practice-mode").json() == {"practice": False, "admin": True}

        assert server.godaddy.writes() and not practice.godaddy.writes()

    with c:
        full_launch(c, practice)

content.text:
# Phase 0 report

## Verification
- **Tests:** 339 passed, 2 skipped (real infrastructure). **Frontend build:** clean.
- **GoDaddy prod API:** HTTP 200, one domain, `launchwitness.com` ACTIVE. Per-shop A records through the API are possible. This proves read access only; the first record write gets verified on Wednesday, with a hand-made wildcard as the fallback.
- **`docs/AUDIT_2026-11-15.md` does not exist** in the repo on any branch. I checked the B/S items in your prompt against the code instead. Please add the file if you have it.
- **I don't have the build-phase evaluation criteria** from the kickoff webinar. Paste them if you can; they could reorder everything below.

## Verdict
The execution is strong, but the idea as it stands is a website builder with a self-test. I'd shortlist it for the Top 10 on execution if the live demo works; I would not put it in the Top 3 yet.

What a skeptical GoDaddy judge says in the first 30 seconds:
1. **"You're testing your own code."** The proof only covers shops LaunchWitness built and hosts, which is a health check. The pitch says "Airo builds, LaunchWitness proves", but it cannot check an Airo site. This is the biggest hole.
2. **"Where's the agent?"** Claude makes three single-shot calls. The Doctor picks one of five options, which is a classifier. The one phase that fixes this (Phase 5) is last and optional.
3. **"Where's GoDaddy?"** With subdomains only and manual purchases, real GoDaddy API use is close to zero unless each launch writes its own DNS record.
4. **"Indian home sellers live on WhatsApp."** An order emailed to an inbox she rarely opens is a weak pipeline.

On your direct questions:
- **Is the problem real?** Yes. Forms and order emails that fail silently are common, but mostly on sites people already have, not on shops we just built.
- **Positioning:** the reliability agent is stronger than the website generator, but only if points 1–3 are fixed. Keep "Is your shop actually ready for customers?" for sellers; "reliability and operations agent" is judge language only.
- **Is monitoring the differentiator?** Not as uptime pings, which are a commodity. A daily real test order with a hop trace and history is the differentiator.
- **What to monitor, by value:** daily test order, then certificate, then the shop's DNS answer, then mailbox plan expiry, then domain expiry. Broken-link checks add nothing on a fixed template.
- **Auto-fix or ask:** fix automatically only what we wrote and the owner already approved (re-point the address, retry the certificate, re-add our records). Restoring a backup or touching records we didn't write needs approval. Money is never automatic.
- **The killer feature:** break something live, and the trace shows which hop died; the Doctor investigates, fixes it and re-proves it, ending in a public receipt.

## Ranked changes
I'd make 1–5 even with the deadline.

1. **"Check any address" on the landing page.** Paste any domain and get read-only public checks (DNS, HTTPS, certificate days left, mail records) in plain English. It makes the pitch true for sites we didn't build and gives judges something to try on their own domain. About 3 hours, reusing checker code, with an SSRF guard.
2. **Promote the investigating Doctor above shop design.** It is the only real agent loop.
3. **Per-shop A records through the GoDaddy API, no wildcard.** This gives real DNS backup, write and authoritative verification per launch, and a safe fault to stage (delete one shop's record). Add a hard guard: on the app zone, code may only write A records for shop slugs, never `@`, `*` or mail records.
4. **One real seller.** Get one actual home seller launched by Thursday, with their own "Yes, I got it" tap in the report. This needs no code and carries the most weight at an inclusive-innovation event.
5. **Keep one WhatsApp link** on the order confirmation page ("Send this order to the shop"). It is about 30 lines and answers objection 4. The rest of the WhatsApp work stays cut.
6. **Minimal bounce check:** look for a bounce carrying the nonce in `hello@`. Only if time allows.

## The audit items
Confirmed in code: B1, B2, B3, B4, B5, B6, B8, B9, S7. I did not check B7 or S6. I could not find phone numbers in audit details (S8), so I'll add a test that locks that in.

Missing from the list:
- **Certificate rate limit.** Let's Encrypt allows about 50 new certificates a week per domain, and every shop subdomain uses one. Live shops need a cap; this also justifies admin approval.
- **One mailbox carries everything.** Sign-in links, order emails and alerts all go through `hello@`. It has a daily send limit (I need to verify the number) and expires around Dec 15, four days after the finale.
- **B4 shrinks if own-domain launches stay practice-only.** Mail-record checks become read-only on the sending domain and nothing writes mail records for real.

## Decisions
I agree with 1–5. Changes I'd argue for:
- **Own-domain launch:** cut it outright, not stretch. Say "subdomains only" in the product.
- **Claim flow:** nothing is deployed, so no owner-link shops exist. Fold it into "guest practice, then sign in to keep it" as one mechanism.
- **Three themes:** one template with three palettes. A prettier shop makes us look more like a builder; design effort goes to the trace and report page.
- **Decision 6:** agree, except for the WhatsApp link in change 5.

## Final plan

| Order | Phase | Scope | Estimate |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Make claims true | As written; B4 reduced as above; app-zone write guard | 2–3 h |
| 2 | Accounts and tenancy ⛔ | As written, minus claim flow, admin rename, own domains; reports queue minimal | 5–7 h |
| 3 | Order proof | As written, plus "Check any address" and the live-shop cap | 4–5 h |
| 4 | Investigating Doctor | Your Phase 5, three staged faults | 2–3 h |
| 5 | Design ⛔ | One template, three palettes; trace/report page first; states and app pages | 2–3 h |
| 6 | Verification and handover | As written; end-to-end tests (a) and (b) in Playwright, (c) as a backend test | 2–3 h |

That is roughly 17–24 hours of working time before Wednesday, so it is tight. If we run short, cut in this order: bounce check, account deletion by email link (use signed-in confirmation), per-user Claude cap (keep the daily describe limit), the axe pass beyond one run, then palettes two and three.

Say "go" to start Phase 1, and tell me which of changes 1–5 and the reorder you accept.

Noted, and the corrected pitch is consistent with the plan. Three things to flag before I start, none blocking:

- **The daily test order can't end in "reached her".** For inboxes we can't read, the daily run proves "form accepted → mail server accepted" only; the "Yes, I got it" tap happens at launch and on demand. I'll word the copy that way.
- **"Writes the records through the GoDaddy API" is unproven until Wednesday.** The docs will say so until the first real write succeeds.
- **The approval card will show $0** for every real launch now that shops are subdomains only. I'll keep the card (it still lists the DNS change) and drop the purchase wording from the real path.

Phase 1 plan (targets audit B1–B9, S2, S5–S8 and the app-zone guard):
- Branch `s9f-proof-accounts-design`; a failing test first for each bug, then the fix.
- Orders: one recipient function for test and real orders, mailer chosen per business, rate limits, idempotency token.
- Public gate: shop pages and certificates only for live, unpaused shops; owner-only preview for the rest.
- Mail provider table, nonce + SINCE in the inbox check, startup reconciler, mode-aware Doctor fixes, `launch_clean` out of the checks.
- App-zone write guard (A records for shop slugs only), one shared running-check guard, `is_owned` needs ACTIVE, practice labels.

"""Session 9F, Phase 1: make the current claims true (audit B1-B9, S2, S5-S8, app-zone guard)."""

import json
from datetime import timedelta

import httpx
import pytest
from sqlmodel import Session, select

from app.agents.checker import checks_for, run_check
from app.agents.launch_check import AlreadyChecking, start_run
from app.agents.playbook import fixes_for
from app.godaddy.client import AppZoneWriteRefused, FakeGoDaddyClient, GoDaddyClient
from app.mail.imap import FakeInboxReader
from app.mail.providers import PROVIDERS
from app.models import AuditEvent, Business, CheckRun, Order, Plan, utcnow
from app.routers.internal import is_allowed_tls_domain
from app.sites.orders import order_recipients
from app.startup import reconcile
from tests.conftest import publish
from tests.test_m3_launch import approve, meera, plan
from tests.test_m4_repair import ctx_for

HOST = {"host": "meera.localhost"}
ORDER = {"qty_0": "1", "customer_name": "Asha Rao", "customer_phone": "98765 43210"}


def launched_shop(client, engine, **save_changes) -> tuple[dict, dict]:
    """A sandbox-launched, public (live, not practice) shop at meera.localhost."""
    biz = meera(client)
    if save_changes:
        r = client.put(f"/api/businesses/{biz['id']}", json={"profile": biz["profile"], "subdomain": "meera",
                                                              **save_changes})
        assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    p = approve(client, plan(client, biz))
    assert p["status"] == "done", p["steps"]
    publish(engine, biz["id"])
    return biz, p


# ---------- B1: orders go to the right person, same function + recipients as the test order ----------

def test_b1_real_and_test_orders_share_recipients(client, engine, integ, settings):
    biz, _p = launched_shop(client, engine, owner_email="meera@example.org")
    test_mail = next(m for m in integ.mailer.sent if "[TEST]" in m["subject"])
    r = client.post("/order", data=ORDER, headers=HOST)
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    real_mail = integ.mailer.sent[-1]
    assert "[TEST]" not in real_mail["subject"]
    assert real_mail["to"] == test_mail["to"]
    assert "meera@example.org" in real_mail["to"] and settings.smtp_user in real_mail["to"]
    with Session(engine) as s:
        assert order_recipients(s, settings, s.get(Business, biz["id"])) == [settings.smtp_user, "meera@example.org"]


# ---------- B2: public-shop gate ----------

def test_b2_draft_and_practice_shops_are_not_public(client, engine, settings):
    biz = meera(client)  # draft, practice
    assert client.get("/", headers=HOST).status_code == 404
    assert client.post("/order", data=ORDER, headers=HOST).status_code == 404
    with Session(engine) as s:
        assert not is_allowed_tls_domain("meera.localhost", settings, s)
    approve(client, plan(client, biz))  # practice launch: "live" but still practice
    assert client.get("/", headers=HOST).status_code == 404
    with Session(engine) as s:
        assert not is_allowed_tls_domain("meera.localhost", settings, s)
    publish(engine, biz["id"])
    assert client.get("/", headers=HOST).status_code == 200
    with Session(engine) as s:
        assert is_allowed_tls_domain("meera.localhost", settings, s)


def test_b2_paused_shop_shows_neutral_page_and_gets_no_certificate(client, engine, settings):
    biz, _ = launched_shop(client, engine)
    with Session(engine) as s:
        b = s.get(Business, biz["id"])
        b.paused = True
        s.add(b)
        s.commit()
        assert not is_allowed_tls_domain("meera.localhost", settings, s)
    r = client.get("/", headers=HOST)
    assert r.status_code == 503 and "This shop is paused" in r.text and "Meera" not in r.text
    assert client.post("/order", data=ORDER, headers=HOST).status_code == 503


def test_b2_owner_preview_needs_the_owner(client):
    biz = meera(client)
    r = client.get(f"/api/businesses/{biz['id']}/preview")
    assert r.status_code == 200 and biz["profile"]["name"].split()[0] in r.text and "Preview" in r.text
    assert client.get(f"/api/businesses/{biz['id']}/preview", headers={"X-Owner-Key": "wrong"}).status_code in (403, 404)


# ---------- B3 + S2 + S5: mailer per business, rate limits, idempotency ----------

def test_b3_practice_shop_never_uses_the_real_mailer(client, engine, integ):
    """A practice order (only possible from the launch check now) goes to the practice world's mailer."""
    from app.mail.smtp import get_mailer

    class Exploding:
        def send(self, **kw):
            raise AssertionError("real mailer used for a shop order")

    client.app.dependency_overrides[get_mailer] = lambda: Exploding()
    launched_shop(client, engine)
    assert client.post("/order", data=ORDER, headers=HOST).status_code == 200
    assert integ.mailer.sent[-1]["subject"].startswith("New order")


def test_s2_orders_are_rate_limited_per_visitor_and_per_shop(client, engine, make_settings):
    from app.config import get_settings

    launched_shop(client, engine)
    client.app.dependency_overrides[get_settings] = lambda: make_settings(orders_per_visitor_per_hour=2,
                                                                          orders_per_shop_per_day=3)
    for _ in range(2):
        assert client.post("/order", data=ORDER, headers=HOST).status_code == 200
    r = client.post("/order", data=ORDER, headers=HOST)
    assert r.status_code == 429 and "few minutes" in r.text
    other = {**HOST, "x-forwarded-for": "203.0.113.9"}
    assert client.post("/order", data=ORDER, headers=other).status_code == 200  # shop total now 3 (test order excluded)
    r = client.post("/order", data=ORDER, headers={**HOST, "x-forwarded-for": "203.0.113.10"})
    assert r.status_code == 429
    with Session(engine) as s:
        assert len(s.exec(select(Order).where(Order.is_test == False)).all()) == 3  # noqa: E712


def test_s5_double_submit_makes_one_order(client, engine, integ):
    launched_shop(client, engine)
    page = client.get("/", headers=HOST).text
    assert 'name="order_token"' in page
    token = page.split('name="order_token" value="', 1)[1].split('"', 1)[0]
    assert len(token) >= 16
    before = len(integ.mailer.sent)
    for _ in range(2):
        r = client.post("/order", data={**ORDER, "order_token": token}, headers=HOST)
        assert r.status_code == 200 and "Thank you" in r.text
    with Session(engine) as s:
        assert len(s.exec(select(Order).where(Order.is_test == False)).all()) == 1  # noqa: E712
    assert len(integ.mailer.sent) == before + 1


# ---------- B4: mail values per provider; never overwrite another provider's working records ----------

def test_b4_provider_table_default_is_secureserver(settings):
    assert settings.mail_provider == "secureserver"
    assert {h for _p, h in PROVIDERS["secureserver"].mx} == {"smtp.secureserver.net", "mailstore1.secureserver.net"}
    assert "include:secureserver.net" in PROVIDERS["secureserver"].spf
    assert "titan" in PROVIDERS


def test_b4_sandbox_checks_mail_settings_read_only(client, engine, integ, settings):
    _biz, p = launched_shop(client, engine)
    ctx = ctx_for(engine, settings, integ, p["id"])
    assert checks_for(ctx) == ["site_points", "https", "email_mx", "email_spf", "email_dkim", "email_dmarc",
                               "test_order"]
    writes = len(integ.godaddy.writes())
    for name in ("email_mx", "email_spf", "email_dkim", "email_dmarc"):
        out = run_check(ctx, name)
        assert out.passed, (name, out.detail)
        assert fixes_for(name, "sandbox") == set()  # nothing may write mail records on the app's own domain
    assert len(integ.godaddy.writes()) == writes


def test_b4_working_mail_of_another_provider_is_never_overwritten(client, engine, integ, settings):
    domain = "meerascakes.in"
    integ.godaddy.owned.add(domain)
    other = [{"type": "MX", "name": "@", "data": "aspmx.l.google.com", "priority": 1, "ttl": 3600}]
    integ.godaddy.zones[domain] = list(other)
    p = approve(client, plan(client, meera(client), "full", domain))
    assert p["status"] == "failed"
    failed = next(s for s in p["steps"] if s["status"] == "failed")
    assert "already" in failed["message"]
    assert [r for r in integ.godaddy.zones[domain] if r["type"] == "MX"] == other


# ---------- B5: the test order carries a nonce; an old email never passes ----------

def test_b5_test_order_has_a_nonce_and_old_mail_does_not_pass(client, engine, integ, settings):
    _biz, p = launched_shop(client, engine)
    with Session(engine) as s:
        first = s.exec(select(Order).where(Order.is_test)).first()
        next_id = s.exec(select(Order).order_by(Order.id.desc())).first().id + 1
    assert len(first.nonce) >= 16
    mail = next(m for m in integ.mailer.sent if "[TEST]" in m["subject"])
    assert first.nonce in mail["subject"] and first.nonce in mail["body"]
    # An old email whose subject matches the NEXT order id (as after a database reset) must not count.
    integ.inbox.deliver(sender="x", to=settings.smtp_user, subject=f"[TEST] New order (#{next_id})", body="old",
                        at=utcnow() - timedelta(days=2))
    integ.mailer.drop = True  # the new test order's email never arrives
    ctx = ctx_for(engine, settings, integ, p["id"])
    out = run_check(ctx, "test_order")
    assert not out.passed


def test_b5_inbox_search_ignores_messages_before_since():
    inbox = FakeInboxReader()
    inbox.deliver(sender="a", to="b", subject="code abc", body="", at=utcnow() - timedelta(hours=1))
    assert inbox.find(subject_contains="abc", since=utcnow() - timedelta(minutes=5)) == []
    assert len(inbox.find(subject_contains="abc", since=utcnow() - timedelta(hours=2))) == 1


# ---------- B6: startup reconciler ----------

def test_b6_reconciler_fails_orphaned_plans_and_check_runs(client, engine):
    biz, p = launched_shop(client, engine)
    with Session(engine) as s:
        orphan = Plan(business_id=biz["id"], mode="sandbox", zone="localhost", site_host="meera.localhost",
                      status="running", steps_json=json.dumps([{"id": "a", "kind": "backup_dns", "title": "t",
                                                               "detail": "", "status": "running", "message": "",
                                                               "started_at": None, "finished_at": None}]))
        s.add(orphan)
        s.add(CheckRun(business_id=biz["id"], plan_id=p["id"], trigger="manual"))
        s.commit()
        orphan_id = orphan.id
    assert reconcile(engine) == {"plans": 1, "check_runs": 1}
    with Session(engine) as s:
        pl = s.get(Plan, orphan_id)
        step = json.loads(pl.steps_json)[0]
        assert pl.status == "failed" and step["status"] == "failed" and "Resume" in step["message"]
        assert "restarted" in step["message"]
        assert s.exec(select(CheckRun).where(CheckRun.status == "running")).all() == []
        stuck = s.exec(select(CheckRun).order_by(CheckRun.id.desc())).first()
        assert stuck.status == "done" and stuck.passed is False
        assert s.exec(select(AuditEvent).where(AuditEvent.action == "reconcile")).all()
    assert reconcile(engine) == {"plans": 0, "check_runs": 0}
    assert client.post(f"/api/plans/{orphan_id}/resume").status_code == 200


# ---------- B7: practice results are labelled ----------

def test_b7_practice_report_is_labelled(client):
    biz = meera(client)
    approve(client, plan(client, biz))
    rep = client.get(f"/api/businesses/{biz['id']}/report").json()
    assert rep["practice"] is True and rep["ready"] is True
    assert rep["headline"] == "Practice run: passed (pretend GoDaddy)"
    assert "ready for customers" not in json.dumps(rep)


# ---------- B8: launch steps are not a check ----------

def test_b8_launch_steps_are_shown_apart_from_checks(client):
    biz = meera(client)
    approve(client, plan(client, biz))
    rep = client.get(f"/api/businesses/{biz['id']}/report").json()
    assert "launch_clean" not in [c["check"] for c in rep["run"]["checks"]]
    assert rep["launch"]["status"] == "done"
    assert [s["status"] for s in rep["launch"]["steps"]] == ["done"] * 5


# ---------- B9: Doctor fixes depend on the launch mode ----------

def test_b9_fixes_depend_on_launch_mode():
    assert fixes_for("test_order", "sandbox") == set()
    assert fixes_for("site_points", "sandbox") == {"repoint_site"}
    assert fixes_for("https", "sandbox") == {"retry_certificate", "repoint_site"}
    assert fixes_for("email_dmarc", "full") == {"readd_email_auth"}
    assert fixes_for("launch_clean", "full") == set()


def test_b9_sandbox_test_order_failure_makes_no_doctor_call(client, engine, integ, settings, claude):
    from app.agents.launch_check import run_checks

    _biz, p = launched_shop(client, engine)
    integ.mailer.drop = True
    calls = len(claude.calls)
    summary = run_checks(engine, settings, integ, claude, p["id"], trigger="manual")
    assert [f.check for f in summary.failed] == ["test_order"]
    assert len(claude.calls) == calls


# ---------- S6: one running-check guard for monitoring and "Run checks now" ----------

def test_s6_one_check_run_at_a_time(client, engine, integ, settings, claude):
    from app.monitor.scheduler import Monitor

    biz, p = launched_shop(client, engine)
    with Session(engine) as s:
        start_run(s, biz["id"], p["id"], "manual")
        with pytest.raises(AlreadyChecking):
            start_run(s, biz["id"], p["id"], "monitor_quick")
        runs = len(s.exec(select(CheckRun)).all())
    assert client.post(f"/api/businesses/{biz['id']}/checks").status_code == 409
    assert Monitor(engine, settings, lambda b: integ, claude).check_business(biz["id"], "quick") == []
    with Session(engine) as s:
        assert len(s.exec(select(CheckRun)).all()) == runs


# ---------- S7: only an ACTIVE domain counts as owned ----------

@pytest.mark.parametrize("status,owned", [("ACTIVE", True), ("PENDING_DNS_ACTIVE", False), ("", False),
                                          ("CANCELLED", False), ("HELD_REGISTRAR", False)])
def test_s7_is_owned_needs_active(settings, status, owned):
    transport = httpx.MockTransport(lambda req: httpx.Response(200, json={"domain": "x.in", "status": status}))
    assert GoDaddyClient(settings, transport=transport).is_owned("x.in") is owned


# ---------- S8: customer phone numbers stay out of the audit log ----------

Path("app/startup.py").write_text('''"""Startup reconciler: launches and check runs are worked on by this process. If the server
restarts in the middle, nothing would ever finish them, and the screens would say "running"
forever. On start we close them honestly: the plan becomes failed with "press Resume", and a
stuck check run becomes done / not passed.
"""

import json

from sqlalchemy.engine import Engine
from sqlmodel import Session, select

from app import audit
from app.models import CheckRun, Plan, utcnow

RESTART_MESSAGE = "The server restarted during your launch. Nothing was lost: press Resume to continue."


def reconcile(engine: Engine) -> dict:
    """Returns how many rows were closed: {"plans": n, "check_runs": n}."""
    with Session(engine) as s:
        plans = s.exec(select(Plan).where(Plan.status.in_(("approved", "running")))).all()  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
        for plan in plans:
            steps = json.loads(plan.steps_json)
            hit = next((st for st in steps if st["status"] == "running"), None) or \\
                next((st for st in steps if st["status"] == "pending"), None)
            if hit is not None:
                hit.update(status="failed", message=RESTART_MESSAGE, finished_at=utcnow().isoformat())
            plan.steps_json, plan.status = json.dumps(steps), "failed"
            s.add(plan)
            audit.record(s, actor="system", action="reconcile", target=f"plan:{plan.id}", result="failed",
                         business_id=plan.business_id, detail="server restarted while this launch was running")
        runs = s.exec(select(CheckRun).where(CheckRun.status == "running")).all()
        for run in runs:
            run.status, run.passed, run.finished_at = "done", False, utcnow()
            s.add(run)
            audit.record(s, actor="system", action="reconcile", target=f"run:{run.id}", result="failed",
                         business_id=run.business_id, detail="server restarted while these checks were running")
        s.commit()
        return {"plans": len(plans), "check_runs": len(runs)}
''', encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")

    or raise: working mail of another service is never replaced (by a launch or by the Doctor)."""

    live = [r for r in ctx.integ.godaddy.get_records(ch["zone"]) if r["type"] == ch["type"] and r["name"] == ch["name"]]

    provider = provider_for(ctx.settings)
    if ch["type"] == "MX":

        if mx_hosts(live) <= {h for _p, h in provider.mx}:

            raise StepFailed(OTHER_MAIL, f"live SPF {spf} does not include {provider.spf_include}")

    return "keep" if {str(r.get("data", "")) for r in live} != {str(r.get("data", "")) for r in records} else "write"
